admin_region_derived.resolution: PERMANENT. This file is the solution, not a stopgap: mWater computes admin_region from location, the nine locations lie just outside its Madagascar boundary polygons on the Antongil Bay shore, so mWater will never assign one and there is nothing for anyone to set in mWater. Coordinates are not to be moved to make the geocoder match. Resolved 2026-09-23.
admin_region_derived.why_not_written: The v3 entities API accepts a PATCH and bumps _rev but silently discards admin_region. Tried as a full-document PATCH and as a minimal {_id,_rev,admin_region} PATCH; both returned 200 and neither persisted the field. admin_region is a declared property of type 'admin_region' and is almost certainly derived server-side or gated behind a route this credential does not have. Two attempts were made on 698771103 and no further writes were attempted. That entity's _rev moved 8 -> 10 with no content change - every other field is byte-identical to the pre-write backup in data/mwater_backups/. The field is not settable in practice because mWater computes it; see resolution.
